top_signals.title: CM Energy to Supply Cable Lay Equipment for Asso.subsea Vessel
top_signals.summary: CM Energy is progressing work on an integrated cable-handling and marine equipment package for a new Asso.subsea vessel, expanding its involvement in the European offshore wind market.The contract covers specialist cable-handling equipment and associated marine systems for the vessel…
